windows.pre_open: 前一交易日收盘后至当日开盘前
windows.prior: 此前 2 至 5 个交易日

metadata.moneyflow: Provider daily money-flow splits (small/medium/large/extra-large orders by trade value); main = large + extra-large. Thresholds: main net flow at or beyond 10% of turnover, extra-large at or beyond 5%, retail absorbing = main net outflow with small-plus-medium net inflow of at least 5%. Shares are of the day's turnover value; they describe observed order sizes, not identified participants.
metadata.as_of_rule: Each item carries its publication time; the replay marks items published at or before the crossing bar's close as known at that moment and later items as disclosed afterwards. The end-of-day attribution uses the full day's windows and is shown as such.
limitations: 概率是 2026 年 7 月样本内的经验关联，不是因果证明，也未在样本外验证。
公告 99% 以上在收盘后发布，公告类原因主要通过前一交易日收盘后至当日开盘前的窗口起作用；当日收盘后的公告只作为事后解释列出。
新闻来源为财经类公众号文章标题与关联股票标签，关键词识别行业与政策，可能漏判或误判。
行业归属来自公告元数据中的行业标签；无公告的股票没有行业层。
成交与盘口证据来自快照代理指标（tick 规则、笔均额），不能识别交易者身份。
日度观察在当日 16:00 后完整；本页不声称盘中可预测。
